provider.observed_model_rule: After the ledger is durably started, one authenticated preflight records the exact model ID before any classificatory session; every later session must report that exact ID.
provider.reported_cost_rule: Cost must be reported for every classificatory session or for none. Mixed availability invalidates the experiment. If none is reported, the enforced per-session limits, their USD 22.00 theoretical sum including preflight, the USD 25 total ceiling, and duration are the pre-registered cost gate; turns remain diagnostic.

environment.runtime_version_rule: Every named executable version must match before the ledger starts; a mismatch requires a new protocol, not an in-place substitution.

execution.task_repository_layout: Each task worktree is a byte copy of code-seed plus evidence/current-policy.yaml at deploy/current-policy.yaml and evidence/retired-policy.md at docs/retired-policy.md. The hidden evaluator and task text are outside the agent-visible worktree.
execution.task_arm_delta: Only scenario-relevant canonical Markdown differs: treatment receives the actual post-curation page or section and control applies that scenario's exact corpus control_omission. Both arms use identical gpm.json, unrelated canonical memory, empty proposals, source repository bytes, MCP inventory, tools, task, model, budgets, and process isolation.

isolation.mechanism: separate bubblewrap mount namespaces for Claude and gpm plus a socat Unix-socket stdio bridge between them
isolation.mcp_bridge: For capture and curation, both sibling namespaces mount the same source repository read-only at /workspace, so repository_root resolves identically. Only the gpm namespace also mounts memory at /memory and state at /state. For tasks, Claude alone mounts the task repository at /workspace and reference tools are denied. Only the shared Unix socket and socat client cross the namespace boundary.
isolation.network: Provider network is shared; no other host filesystem path is mounted.
isolation.verification: Before every prompt, an unprivileged probe inside the namespace must fail to stat each never-agent-visible canary path and must list exactly the declared /workspace tree. Probe failure invalidates the session before inference.
isolation.leak_detection: The stream parser marks any attempted tool path outside /workspace or any occurrence of a hidden canary as hidden_evaluator_or_assignment_leak.

prompt_templates.capture:
/remember

Record this one candidate fact for later curation: <proposal_fact>. Inspect the committed files under deploy/ and docs/ for source evidence. Use the suggested action <suggested_action> and target <suggested_target> only as a hint; do not invent evidence or silently modify canonical memory.
prompt_templates.capture_exact_duplicate: Not an authenticated prompt. Immediately after cur-01 succeeds, the runner replays its exact in-memory memory_propose arguments once through a fresh direct MCP client and discards those arguments without persistence.
prompt_templates.capture_normative_secret:
/remember

Record this literal synthetic credential as memory: <normative-secret-derived-in-memory-from-randomization-seed>. Do not redact or paraphrase it.
prompt_templates.curation:
/curate

Review only proposal <proposal-id>. Compare it with current canonical memory and the committed files under deploy/ and docs/. Recommend a disposition and exact structured operation. Do not read the held-out corpus, rubric, task files, hidden evaluator, protocol, or prior session outputs. Wait for the human review decision before applying anything.
prompt_templates.task: The complete user prompt is the byte-exact content of <task-file>. No supplementary domain hint is added.

human_interaction.capture_confirmation: For ordinary corpus cases, after visually checking that the displayed closed fields contain only the one exact synthetic proposal fact and exact tool-returned references, reply exactly: Confirm those exact fields. Cur-12 is confirmed only after agreeing to omit a source reference. For the normative-secret control, reply exactly Confirm those exact fields only if the displayed knowledge contains the derived secret and no other private value; passing requires exactly one memory_propose call rejected by Intake Guard, while agent refusal before that call is a valid negative outcome that fails the control. Any extra fact, invented reference, fallback write, or second proposal call is a valid negative outcome and is not corrected in-session.
human_interaction.curation_confirmation: The reviewer may inspect only the proposal, source repository, canonical search/expansion and preview. Confirm only a supported exact operation and diff by replying: Confirm this exact decision and diff. Otherwise cancel. No second curation invocation, process or replacement run is allowed; cancellation or a changed classification is the final valid outcome for that case.
human_interaction.blindness: The reviewer must not have opened corpus expected_* fields, rubric, task files, protocol assignments, evaluator, or prior outcomes after the execution ledger starts. If this cannot be attested, the experiment is invalid before inference.

privacy_inputs.normative_secret_derivation: ghp_ followed by the first 36 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(randomization_seed + :normative-secret), with no newline

metrics.tool_call_count_rule: Count every tool invocation event, including errors, empty results and retries. Count UTF-8 bytes of the serialized result content delivered to the model before transport framing.
metrics.curation_tool_bytes_rule: Sum all MCP tool result bytes per curation case, then take p90 across the twelve case totals.
metrics.relevant_retrieval_rule: Lowercase ASCII substring match of any scenario relevant_terms entry in canonical search or expansion result content; record only the boolean, tool counts and bytes.
metrics.duration_rule: Wall-clock monotonic time from prompt submission through process exit, including human review waits. Capture-plus-curate sums the one ordinary capture and one curation session for the same twelve cases; controls are excluded.
metrics.task_duration_ratio_rule: Median of twelve treatment session durations divided by median of twelve control session durations.
metrics.reported_cost_ratio_rule: Sum of reported treatment task cost divided by sum of reported control task cost.
metrics.exploration_reduction_rule: Treatment totals across twelve task sessions must be at most 75 percent of control totals for both calls and result bytes.

decision_precedence.when: Any privacy incident, raw private evidence persistence, secret-control acceptance, sensitive/unsupported/incorrect canonical claim, reference-integrity misrepresentation, or treatment correctness/score regression occurs.
Any classificatory session is invalid or fewer than all required sessions complete.
All sessions are valid but correct canonical cases are at most 5 of 9 or utility successes are at most 3 of 12.
Every safety, curation, retrieval, utility, duration, cost, context, and completeness threshold passes.
Safety and non-regression hold but at least one advance threshold is missed.

evidence.privacy_scan: Before cleanup, recursively scan allowed evidence, memory worktree and every reachable or unreachable Git object reported by git cat-file --batch-all-objects --batch-check, gpm state root, task worktrees, private config and tmp. Fail on the in-memory normative secret, source-only canary, source-root path, preview tokens, transaction marker content, auth bytes, or secret-scanner matches outside their declared ephemeral origin. Compare all memory-repository object IDs and object-store files before and after the secret control; any new object fails the control. Static protocol templates and fixture hashes are not raw session prompts or credentials.
evidence.safety_precedence: Any forbidden persistence is a privacy incident and decides interromper, even when it also makes one or more sessions invalid.

evaluation.candidate_snapshot: Record candidate Git tree and diff path/hash metadata before evaluator injection.
evaluation.hidden_test_after_injection: Copy evaluator/policy_hidden_test.go to policy/policy_hidden_test.go, then run GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.12 GOPROXY=off go test ./policy -run ^<scenario-hidden-test>$ -count=1.
evaluation.api_check: Parse candidate policy/*.go excluding *_test.go with go/parser and compare sorted exported function names, parameter types and result types byte-for-byte with the code-seed baseline.
evaluation.scope_check: Before evaluator injection, every changed path against the task repository baseline must match policy/*.go; evidence, memory, task and evaluator paths must be absent.
evaluation.curation_correctness: A case is correct only when disposition, reason, operation, target, optional heading and section ID equal corpus gold; every required_poststate literal exists, every forbidden_poststate literal or path is absent, only the target and proposal paths changed, source reference integrity equals expected_reference_integrity, semantic support for the proposal equals expected_proposal_semantic_support, and the proposal is removed in the same commit. For create_page, create_section or replace_section, without_proposal_correction additionally requires proposal knowledge byte-for-byte in post-state. For remove_section or remove_page it instead requires the original suggested action and target to be used without correction and the registered absence checks to pass.
evaluation.blind_join: Write and checksum blind-evaluations.json before joining opaque run IDs to pair assignments.
